eli: Quick bring-up: ran a focused 800-sample sweep for arcus-9b int6 vs fp16 on multi-turn synth + extractive QA. High-level below.
naya: drop numbers pls.
eli: perf/cost:
``nint6 throughput: 710 tok/s (fp16 baseline 390 tok/s)
avg p50 latency: 58ms -> 96ms (int6 faster)
unit_cost_per_1k: $0.0018 (int6) vs $0.0032 (fp16) -> ~44% savings
```
frank: solid. quality?
eli: aggregate F1: fp16=0.74, int6=0.72 (-0.02). Long entity-copy slice shows -4pt EM on ~9% of cases. Short QA unchanged. Token ppl on fails: fp16=7.4, int6=9.0.
naya: pattern sounds like attention drift on extended spans. Any quick hacks tried?
eli: tried entity-priming (prepend entity list) recovered ~50% of fails. Also tried final-logit rescale (+0.02) gave modest gains but increased repeat ngrams on some prompts.
frank: econ routing thought: route long-doc synth to fp16 only for queries >1400 tokens or when entity-density>0.1. what's blended cost?
eli: if 12% traffic is long, blended = 0.12*$0.0032 + 0.88*$0.0018 = $0.00204 (~36% vs baseline). If we instead use signal-based castback that triggers on entropy>5.2 for ~6% tokens, blended ~= $0.00192 (~40% saving).
ops-bot: capacity-check: arcus-9b fp16 pool headroom: us-west 10%, eu-west 8%. 12% long-route predicts +11% QPS on fp16.
reliability-bot: recommend shadow fp16 for 3% traffic to validate live quality delta before any active routing.
naya: plan: 1) eli run 2k-sample entropy-sim sweep and post per-slice deltas (ETA 6h) 2) ops simulate 12% length-route capacity and try 3% shadow (ETA 24h) 3) product prepare GTN note with blended econ + UX latency expectations (ETA tomorrow).
eli: will run sweep now and include per-slice fail-mode annotations + recommended entropy thresholds. tagging @frank for rollout signoff.
frank: agree with shadow-first then gradual opt-in. :thumbsup:
